{"consolidated_memory":"notifications/push/dispatch.py - Silent drop issues in dispatcher (two separate occasions)

Component: notifications/push/dispatch.py (notifications side)
Test coverage: tests/notifications/test_dispatch.py
Stack: Python

OCCASION 1 [2026-02-28]:
- Scope: Silent drop only in accounts within five percent rollout bucket
- Signal: Send reports success but no delivery occurs
- Root cause: Config loader reading wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #1281 on branch fix/silent-drop-1
- Repro: Dispatch to device token that was rotated
- Outcome: Flaky test improved from 25 failures per 100 runs to zero failures

OCCASION 2 [2026-04-27]:
- Scope: Silent drop only for jobs scheduled across midnight boundary
- Signal: Send reports success but no delivery occurs
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made default empty and built value per call
- PR #6465 on branch fix/silent-drop-4
- Repro: Dispatch to device token that was rotated
- Outcome: Cold start latency dropped 84%, down to 304 ms"}
